answers.core: Notepad++ is a common text editor, and this is an engine enhancement that would support it, but the general case would also support all other editors that have command line restrictions.
answers.workaround:
One can simply skip opening the workspace in Notepad++, or leave the same workspace always open, but this becomes a problem if you switch projects.

One can also create a set of custom settings for Notepad++ specifically for Godot and call those as a commandline flag: [-settingsDir="d:\your settings dir\"]

title: Allow multiple calls for launching External Editors
